tagline.en_US: The maintained jlesage MKVToolNix image with browser GUI, persistent settings and user-selectable shared storage.

description.en_US: MKVToolNix is a suite of tools designed to create, alter, and inspect Matroska files. It enables users to multiplex, edit, and organize video, audio, and subtitle streams into MKV containers without re-encoding. The software provides an intuitive graphical interface alongside command-line utilities to inspect track headers, split files, and adjust container metadata.
